title: Cod and Potato Skillet with Cheddar-Chive Gravy
description: Tender potato slices and broad flakes of cod share a chowder-style skillet with enough cheddar-chive gravy to spoon over every bite.

ingredients.name: skinless Atlantic cod loin
ingredients.note: Weight after skin and pin bones are removed. Divide into two even portions about 3/4 to 1 inch thick. Fully thaw before cooking.

ingredients.name: Yukon Gold potatoes
ingredients.note: Peel, then slice into thin half-moons about 1/8 inch thick.

ingredients.name: low-sodium chicken broth
ingredients.note: Choose unsalted plain meat-and-water broth without a vegetable blend.

steps.title: Soften the potatoes
steps.text: Simmer {potato} with {broth} in the covered HexClad over medium-low heat for 8–12 minutes, until a fork slides easily through the slices.

steps.title: Nestle the cod
steps.text: Stir {milk} into the potatoes and bring back to a bare simmer. Reserve a spoonful of hot broth in a clean cup. Lay {fish} on top and spoon milky broth over the exposed surface.

steps.title: Poach the portions
steps.text: Cover over low heat for 6–12 minutes, checking the thickest centers from 5 minutes. Pull each piece at 135°F.

steps.title: Rest the cod
steps.text: Lift the fish gently onto a warm plate and moisten with the reserved broth. Cover and rest for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Turn the broth into gravy
steps.text: Bring the potato broth back to a simmer. Stir the slurry into the liquid around the slices and cook for 1 minute, until the gravy coats the back of a spoon.

steps.title: Melt the cheddar
steps.text: Off heat, fold in {cheddar} a little at a time, then stir in {chives}.

steps.title: Check carryover and doneness
steps.text: After resting, check each thickest center for about 140°F. Open a natural seam with a fork. The center should be opaque and separate easily into flakes. If either cue is unclear or the center is below 140°F, finish covered in hot sauce in the HexClad over low heat to a measured 145°F, checking every minute.

steps.title: Spoon into bowls
steps.text: Ladle the potatoes and some gravy into bowls. Rest each cod portion on the potatoes and spoon over the remaining cheddar-chive gravy.

notes: Sauce yield: About 1 1/2 cups of gravy for two in addition to the potatoes. Make ahead: Slice the potatoes up to a day ahead and refrigerate submerged in water. Drain before cooking. Refrigerate in shallow portions within 2 hours. Use refrigerated leftovers within 3 days. Freezer-Friendly Verdict: No. Reheated frozen potato slices can turn mealy and the cheese gravy can separate. Refrigerated portions keep the intended texture better. Fridge reheat: Warm a portion covered in its sauce over medium-low heat in the HexClad. Add a little water if it has thickened in storage. Check from 5 minutes and heat to 165°F at the coldest center. Freezer reheat: If frozen, thaw the covered portion in the refrigerator overnight, then follow the fridge method. For a dairy-free gravy, use plain unsweetened oat milk and replace cheddar with whipped dairy-free cream cheese. Estimated nutrition per serving (1/2 of recipe): 282 kcal, 33.2 g protein, 25.6 g total carbohydrate, 4.8 g fat, 1.4 g fiber, 199 mg sodium. Includes both the fish and its full share of sauce and any rice or potatoes listed. Sodium varies with the broth.
